idea: How to maintain a water tank
title: Essential Routine Maintenance for Home Water Storage Tanks
description: Clean household water starts with proper storage tank maintenance. Inspect your residential water tank at least once a year to prevent sediment buildup and bacterial growth. Start by isolating the water supply and draining the tank completely. Gently scrub the interior walls using a soft-bristle brush and clean water—never use harsh chemical cleaners that can leave harmful residues. Inspect the mechanical float valve to ensure it closes tightly and prevents continuous overflowing. Ensure the overflow pipe screen remains secured to keep insects and debris out before refilling the tank. If you notice cracked fittings, persistent leaks, or valve failures, contact a licensed plumber.
